decisions.reason: The main-board layout is referenced only as the precedent for the proposed solution; the source decision changes the sensor-board arrangement and does not modify the main board.
The source decision concerns moving and orienting items on the sensor board and does not change any power-board mechanical constraint.
Rearranging sensor-board items does not change the required connectors, their pinouts, or the connector count.
The mechanical rearrangement does not alter sensor logic levels, level-shifter requirements, or the adapter-board policy.
Moving board items does not change the requirement to hardwire the SPS30 SEL pin to ground for I2C operation.
The sensor-board placement adjustment does not change the main board's connector inventory or connector architecture.
The sensor-board mechanical rearrangement does not affect monitored rails, monitor placement, or current-coverage semantics.
The source decision does not alter the switched 5V supply, its GPIO control, or its powered loads.
The sensor-board item placement and orientation change does not modify any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The mechanical rearrangement leaves the board-chain order, power connectors, rails, and forwarding behavior unchanged.
The source decision does not affect the main-board LED supply voltage, switching, or data-level handling.
Moving sensor-board items does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or the rail powered during debugging.
